```{r}
kidz_bop_raw <- read_csv("~/SDS264_F26/projects/KB_censored-lyrics.csv")

kidz_bop <- kidz_bop_raw |>
  select(ogArtist, songName, badword, count, category, year, ogLyric, kbLyric)
```


```{r}
kidz_bop |> # number/proportion of verses that are cut entirely rather than reworded (by category)
  mutate(cut_line = if_else(kbLyric == "cuts verse", TRUE, FALSE)) |>
  group_by(year, category) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            num_cut = sum(cut_line),
            prop_cut = mean(cut_line)) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = prop_cut, color = category)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~category)
```
